title: Tessellated Isotropic Elastic Lattice Spring Model for Quasi-Brittle Fracture
summary: Quasi-brittle fracture is prevalent in concrete, rock, ceramics, composites, and masonry, and its simulation faces a trade-off among accuracy, efficiency, and simplicity. The classical Lattice Spring Model (LSM) captures cracking via bond breakage without remeshing, but its elements are empirical and limited to a few tessellable shapes with fixed Poisson's ratios.
